name: Iva Jovic
intro: Iva Jovic is 18 and from Torrance, California. She is the youngest player in the top 20. She reached the quarterfinals of the Australian Open this year.
story: Iva started tennis at age five. She also swam and played soccer as a kid. She and her big sister Mia battled in practice sets. Iva could not stand losing! In 2024 she won two big junior doubles titles.

funFacts.text: She lives near the beach. She loves surfing, boogie boarding, and paddleboarding.
Her favorite fun days are at Six Flags and Knott's Berry Farm.
She speaks Serbian at home. Her parents are both pharmacists.
As a kid she waited two and a half hours for Novak Djokovic's autograph.
Her big sister Mia plays college tennis at UCLA.
She says swimming built her muscles and soccer built her footwork.
She was the youngest American woman to win a US Open match since 2000.

watchFor: Watch her hit her two-handed backhand hard and low across the court.
